name: Northfold Manor
summary: The Syndicate holds Northfold Manor in northwestern Arathi. Once a prosperous human homestead, the estate fell into ruin after Stromgarde collapsed and now shelters criminals and dark practices.

sections.title: A Den of Brigands
sections.body:
Near the passage through Thoradin's Wall, Northfold Manor spreads across the rolling highlands. The estate once supported the kingdom of Stromgarde. After the realm fractured, displaced Alteraci nobles and Syndicate outlaws claimed the manor house, barn, and fields as their base.

Mercenaries, highwaymen, and pathstalkers gather there, leaving the crops untended. From the farmstead, they ambush travelers on nearby roads and coordinate the Syndicate's presence across Arathi.

sections.title: Demonic Undertones
sections.body: Demonic summoning has marked Northfold Manor. Sensitive spellcasters and shamans in the region feel traces that linger across the grounds. Bloodstone amulets, potent talismans used to fuel dark invocations, lie discarded there. Their presence points to Syndicate rogues entangling themselves with demonic magic beyond ordinary banditry.

faq.answer: The Syndicate controls Northfold Manor and uses the estate as an armed encampment. Its ranks include dispossessed Alteraci nobles, bandits, and rogue mercenaries.

faq.q: What dark magic is being practiced here?
faq.answer: Those sensitive to magic can feel lingering traces of demonic summoning at Northfold Manor. Syndicate forces there possess bloodstone amulets that help channel dangerous demonic rituals.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this farm?
faq.answer: At Hammerfall, the troll shaman Tor'gan sensed an unnatural disturbance brewing across the highlands. His search for its source led him to Northfold Manor, where the Horde now investigates the Syndicate's occult activities.
Singer is an elusive Syndicate figure sometimes seen among the brigands inside Northfold Manor's main house.

angles.text: Hammerfall's shamans keep watch over Northfold Manor. They send warriors to seize the bloodstone talismans the Syndicate uses in attempts at demonic summoning.
As a shaman, you may feel demonic residue around Northfold Manor disrupting the natural elements. It brings spiritual unease and fiery rage to shamans attuned to the elements.
